metadata.title: Counter-Strike 2 cs_script Map Scripting API Reference
metadata.format: Flat JSON table; one object per searchable API symbol, overload, field, enum member, or inherited callable name.

included: Every declaration in Valve's public cs_script/point_script TypeScript declaration snapshot
All exported classes and declared methods
Inherited callable names expanded for direct lookup
All type aliases, interfaces, and fields
All enums and enum members with resolved numeric values
All deprecated declarations and experimental declarations
not_included: CounterStrikeSharp, Metamod, SourceMod, or other third-party plugin APIs
The separate CS2 console command/convar catalog
Every Hammer entity keyvalue/input/output name; those are entity-I/O definitions rather than cs_script JavaScript declarations

important_notes: GetExplodeTime, GetDefuseStartTime, and GetDefuseFinishTime return absolute game times, not remaining durations.
The public API type name ModfiyPlayerDamageResult and method GetLocalVelcoity are misspelled in Valve's declaration; this file preserves those exact public spellings.
Inherited rows are convenience expansions. Their signatures are declared on the declared_on class and callable on the owner class through inheritance.
Valve can change this API in future CS2 updates; this snapshot is tied to the source commit and build above.

columns.id: Stable row number within this generated snapshot.
columns.command: Searchable API symbol, such as CSPlantedC4.GetExplodeTime.
columns.kind: Class, method, callback registration, inherited method, enum member, type, interface, or field.
columns.signature: Exact or normalized TypeScript declaration signature.
columns.owner: Class, enum, type, interface, or singleton that owns the symbol.
columns.returns: Return type or field type when applicable.
columns.declared_on: Class on which a callable is formally declared.
columns.inherited: Present only for expanded inherited callable rows.
columns.value: Resolved numeric enum value when applicable.

archive_format: gzip split into ordered binary chunks
